name: Gran Melia Palacio de Isora
positioning: Beachfront resort on Tenerife's Atlantic shore at the foot of Teide, with a saltwater infinity pool, Spa by Clarins and RedLevel villas and suites
best_for: Couples and families wanting a beachfront resort with a big pool scene
Travelers who want private villas with their own pool and butler service
Guests keen on Tenerife's nature, from stargazing on Teide to whale watching at sea

facts.text: The resort sits on the shores of the Atlantic Ocean at the foot of Teide.
The resort is on the beachfront, with direct access to the beach.
The spa is Spa by Clarins, which pairs Clarins products with manual massage techniques.
The spa's water circuit includes a sauna, chromotherapy, hydromassage, essence showers, bi-thermal foot baths and a meditation area.
The Deluxe Ocean Front View room has a private terrace with panoramic views of the Atlantic.
RedLevel guests get access to a private lounge, private check-in and check-out, and an a la carte breakfast in a private area.
The villas come with personalised butler service.
The Mar de Nubes kids' club is a supervised area for children.
Dos Naifes by Jorge Peñate was awarded a Sol Repsol in 2025.
At Dos Naifes, chefs Jorge Peñate and Luis Martín focus on marine biodiversity and local seafood.
A private guided outing explores the lava fields of the Malpaís de Rasca and ends with a volcanic wine tasting in Vilaflor.
The hotel is very close to golf courses.

highlights.text: The resort has a saltwater infinity pool.
The RedLevel Villa with Private Pool is a beachfront villa with a furnished garden and heated pool.
The hotel offers a private stargazing experience at Mount Teide with an accredited Starlight guide and long-range telescopes.
The hotel offers private sailing trips along the Tenerife coast aboard a Bavaria 46 Cruiser with a cetacean guide, with chances to spot dolphins and pilot whales.

considerations.text: The private experiences are subject to weather conditions.
Gym personal training, nutritional guidance and customised training programmes carry an extra charge.
WhataHotel notes the large resort may feel less intimate for some guests.
